== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee (Japanese)|I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/154944008/xc-ubOXv_02RczPzTB7v3Q.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 88099879.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>946ca2f8a46aa36e96f4dbc4a86546c21ff1a8b702b3e2874666bc9387209e98</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
